purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined urban church whose worship, congregation, pastoral, service, and vertical landmark functions remain spatially coherent.
architectural_rules: The principal entry must establish a strong axial or intentionally composed route toward the primary worship focus.
Nave/main hall, altar/chancel, and congregation seating geometry must remain mutually legible despite ruin.
Community and pastoral rooms must connect plausibly without overwhelming or replacing the primary worship volume.
Tower, gallery, or upper landmark volumes, when present, must have supported access and credible load paths.
Damage may challenge traversal but must preserve enough spatial hierarchy for the building to remain recognizably ecclesiastical.

damage_doctrine.intent: Urban worship building weathered and structurally wounded while preserving its dominant sacred/civic spatial hierarchy.
